status: source-first planning only; no collector or execution selected
author: /root/evidence_and_next_target
purpose: Resolve request setup, canonical temporary-owner/precision/pi incidence; additionally require internal loop outcome fields before claiming atan iteration counts.
primary_question: Which independent pi constructions repeat across distinct canonical-target arithmetic owners, and is a native matched-precision parent with an eligible completed pi present?
trigger: Prepare an exact collector only if a distinct C052 source design survives numerical/authority and cost feasibility but still lacks necessary incidence evidence.

boundaries: _Arithmetic construction, pi, _atan_small through original calls only
source_inspection.required_gate_map: Every native check, callback, observer, ownership and exception route active across setup, including getters and recursive callbacks.
source_inspection.initial_constraint: No arithmetic method, callback, check, numeric observer, work counter, limit or clock replacement. No trace/profile change that alters native eligibility.
source_inspection.outer_wrapper_limit: Outer build_reference/_canonical_targets wrappers alone do not expose child precision, pi call outcomes or atan loop indices.
source_inspection.stop_condition: If a neutral bounded mechanism for required internal fields is not source-established, stop at a design rejection and leave counts unknown; do not execute or weaken required fields.

identity: per-process raw parent/child/work identity plus scoped stable ordinals
complete native callback nesting and both recording observers
entry: original precision index, bits, scale and current operand/cache domains
parent and child pi-key existence and ordered cache state
outcome: returned/refused/raised with exact original error identity assertion
completed child precision and reason for retry
pi miss/hit/result identity under independently authenticated observation
atan_extension: exact argument native type/value, sign/range path
completed iteration count and terminal loop index
first strict stop versus exception versus finite nonconvergence
observation_fields.missing_event_policy: An absent event is usable only when complete bounded coverage was achieved.

proposed_diagnostic_limits.retention: Copied validated primitive data only; no extra frames, bound methods, arithmetic owners or numerical result objects kept alive.
proposed_diagnostic_limits.on_overflow: Mark census incomplete, stop collecting and preserve the product path and original exception. No success or zero count inferred.

review_gates: Exact frozen collector bytes, finite allocation proof and no product import during preparation.
Independent authority/numerical review of collection neutrality and complete field coverage.
Independent all-path diagnostic-limit review; serialization/retention overhead disclosed.
Separate reviewed fresh-request execution scope with complete input closure and active exclusive window after all workers pause.

compare: entire work counters and category dictionaries
ordered cache and native payload summaries under explicit identity normalization
program/source/options and relevant complete request state
original error type/message/object identity assertion and underlying frames
successful report/GLB bytes only if both requests actually succeed
invalidate_on: unapproved trace/profile or mutated native authority
future_pair.timing: Observation overhead recorded separately; a single pair cannot establish elapsed neutrality or speedup.
future_pair.failed_prefix_limit: A matching failed pair reports only executed prefix state. Complete request saving and the unexecuted tail remain unknown.

required_outputs: source-bound collector plan and independent review
exact driver bytes only after the mechanism is selected and reviewed
fresh pair raw streams/commands/input manifests if separately executed
independent pair/cache/identity audit with failed and incomplete outcomes preserved
